quiz.q: What does embedding a struct (a field with no name) give you?
options: promotion of the inner type's fields and methods
a pointer to the inner struct
quiz.why: The inner type's fields and methods are promoted to the outer type.

quiz.q: Which verb prints a struct WITH its field names?
quiz.why: %+v adds field names. %#v prints Go syntax.

quiz.q: In Go you don't instantiate a class. Instead you...
options: create a VALUE of a TYPE
quiz.why: Go is all about types and values.

quiz.q: What is a good use for an anonymous struct?
quiz.why: Anonymous structs can't have methods and aren't reusable, so they suit one-off data.

quiz.q: What is the zero value of a struct?
options: a struct whose fields all hold their zero values
quiz.why: Every field is set to its own zero value.
